### Notation for Parameters and Statistics

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
symbols <- data.frame(Response = c("quantitative", "categorical",
                                   "quantitative", "categorical",
                                   "quantitative", "quantitative" 
                                   # "quantitative", "categorical"
                                   ),
                         Explanatory = c("-", "-",
                                         "categorical",
                                         "categorical",
                                         "quantitative",
                                         "quant and/or cat"
                                         # "categorical",
                                         # "categorical"
                                         ),
                         Numerical_Quantity = c("mean", 
                                                "proportion",
                                                "difference in means",
                                                "difference in proportions",
                                                "correlation",
                                                "regression coefficient"
                                                # "difference in many means",
                                                # "difference in many proportions"
                                                ),
                         Parameter = c("$\\mu$", "$p$", 
                                       "$\\mu_1 - \\mu_2$",
                                       "$p_1 - p_2$",
                                       "$\\rho$",
                                       "$\\beta$"
                                       # "$F_{true}$",
                                       # "$\\chi^2_{true}$"
                                       ),
                                       Statistic = c("$\\bar{x}$",
                                                     "$\\hat{p}$",
                                                     "$\\bar{x}_1 - \\bar{x}_2$",
                                                     "$\\hat{p}_1 - \\hat{p}_2$",
                                                     "$r$",
                                                     "$\\hat{\\beta}$"
                                                     # "$F$",
                                                     # "$\\chi^2$"
                                                     ))

symbols %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(format="markdown") 

```


### Common Test Statistics and Theoretical Null Distributions (Hypothesis Testing)

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
dists <- data.frame(Numerical_Quantity = c("mean", 
                                           "proportion",
                                           "difference in means",
                                           "difference in proportions",
                                           # "correlation",
                                           "regression coefficient"
                                           # "difference in many means",
                                           # "difference in many proportions"
),
Common_H0 = c("$\\mu = \\mu_0$", "$p = p_0$", "$\\mu_1 - \\mu_2 = 0$", "$p_1 - p_2 = 0$", "$\\beta = 0$"
),
Test_Statistic = c("$\\dfrac{\\bar{x} - \\mu_0}{s/\\sqrt{n}}$",
                   "$\\widehat{p}$",
                   "$\\dfrac{\\bar{x}_1 - \\bar{x}_2 - 0}{\\sqrt{\\dfrac{s^2_1}{n_1} + \\dfrac{s^2_2}{n_2}}}$",
                   "$\\widehat{p}_1 - \\widehat{p}_2$",
                   # "$\\frac{r - 0}{\\sqrt{\\frac{1 - r^2}{n - 2}}}$",
                   "$\\dfrac{\\widehat{\\beta} - 0}{\\widehat{SE}(\\widehat{\\beta})}$"
                   # "$F = \\frac{\\mbox{avg. variation between groups}}{\\mbox{avg. variation within groups}}$",
                   # "$\\chi^2 = \\sum_{cells}\\left(\\frac{\\mbox{observed - expected}}{\\sqrt{\\mbox{expected}}}\\right)^2$"
),
Null_Distribution = c("$t(df = n - 1)$", "$N \\left(p_0, \\sqrt{\\frac{p_0(1 - p_0)}{n}} \\right)$", "$t(df = \\min(n_1, n_2) - 1)$",
                 "$N \\left( 0, \\sqrt{\\dfrac{\\hat{p}_{pooled}(1 - \\hat{p}_{pooled})}{n_1} + \\dfrac{\\hat{p}_{pooled}(1 - \\hat{p}_{pooled})}{n_2}} \\right)$", # "$t(df = n - 2)$",
                 "$t(df = n - p)$"
                 # "$F(df1 = K - 1, df2 = n - K)$", "$\\chi^2(df = (k - 1)(j - 1))$"
),
Assumptions = c("$n \\geq 30$ or data are normal",
                "10 successes, 10 failures",
                "$n_1, n_2 \\geq 30$ or data are normal, independent samples",
                "10 successes, 10 failures in each category, independent samples",
                # "$n \\geq 30$",
                "LINE conditions"
                # "($n \\geq 30$ or data are normal) AND similar variability between groups",
                # "5 oberservations in each cell"
))

dists %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(format="markdown")

```

### Common Distribution-Based Confidence Interval Formulae

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
cis <- data.frame(Numerical_Quantity = c("mean", 
                                                "proportion",
                                                "difference in means",
                                                "difference in proportions",
                                                # "correlation",
                                                "regression coefficient"),
                         Confidence_Interval = c("$\\bar{x} \\pm t^*s/\\sqrt{n}$",
                                            "$\\hat{p} \\pm z^* \\sqrt{\\frac{\\hat{p}(1 - \\hat{p})}{n}}$",
                                            "$(\\bar{x}_1 - \\bar{x}_2) \\pm t^* \\sqrt{\\frac{s^2_1}{n_1} + \\frac{s^2_2}{n_2}}$",
                                            "$(\\hat{p}_1 - \\hat{p}_2) \\pm z^* \\sqrt{\\frac{\\hat{p}_1(1 - \\hat{p}_1)}{n_1} + \\frac{\\hat{p}_2(1 - \\hat{p}_2)}{n_2}}$",
                                            # "$r \\pm t^* \\sqrt{\\frac{1 - r^2}{n - 2}}$",
                                            "$\\hat{\\beta} \\pm t^* \\widehat{SE}(\\hat{\\beta})$"),
                    Critical_Value_Distribution = c("$t(df = n - 1)$", "$N(0, 1)$", "$t(df = \\min(n_1, n_2) - 1)$",
                                     "$N(0, 1)$",
                                     # "$t(df = n - 2)$",
                                     "$t(df = n - p)$"),
                  Assumptions = c("$n \\geq 30$ or data are normal",
                                  "10 successes, 10 failures",
                                  "$n_1, n_2 \\geq 30$ or data are normal, independent samples",
                                  "10 successes, 10 failures in each category, independent samples",
                                  # "$n \\geq 30$",
                                  "LINE conditions"))

cis %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(format="markdown")

```
